nodes.label: 2026-06-11 Conversation Log — Native Libraries & Java Version Fixes
Apple Silicon (arm64) LWJGL/Java Native Compatibility Layer
nodes.rationale: Mojang's 1.18.x-and-earlier LWJGL natives are x86_64-only; on arm64 Java this crashes RenderSystem. mc_compat.rs implements Prism-style MacosArm64Override tables (LWJGL3 3.3.1 for 1.13-1.18, community-compiled LWJGL2 for <=1.12) that swap classpath entries and natives based on detected Java architecture, falling back to Rosetta x64 when arm64 Java/LWJGL isn't available.

nodes.label: Java Version Selection: Global/Instance/Custom Modes
nodes.rationale: Final design uses a 3-mode dropdown (global/minecraft/custom) rather than exposing every Mojang runtime component, since users don't need to pick JRE builds manually; a custom path takes priority over a runtime component when both could apply.

nodes.label: System Java Scan + Native File Picker
nodes.rationale: scan_system_javas() probes common per-OS install locations (JVM dirs, Homebrew, JAVA_HOME, sdkman/asdf, JetBrains ~/.jdks) so users can pick from a list instead of typing a path; rfd AsyncFileDialog with the xdg-portal backend on Linux avoids a GTK3 build dependency for AppImage packaging.

nodes.label: Prism-Style Instance Detail Window (11 Tabs)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the old single EditInstanceDialog with a sidebar-tabbed detail window (logs, version, mods, resource/shader packs, notes, worlds, servers, screenshots, settings, other logs) modeled on Prism Launcher; includes a minimal NBT parser with depth/length guards for reading level.dat/servers.dat.
